class: A hand-kept list of job boards was the only guard, and it was checked only where a link comes in
symptom: Erias Ventures via Adzuna, 30 September: a LinkedIn link led to adzuna.com, whose 'Apply for this job' is Adzuna's own easy-apply behind an Adzuna login. The link was accepted, the run tried to sign in to Adzuna, an overlay blocked the Apply button, and the run stalled for the owner.
site: Adzuna; any job board or aggregator not on the list
root_cause: job_sources refused only LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice (and four aggregators), and only in resolve_job; the account step had no idea whether the site it was signing in to was the employer's.
why_tests_missed: The refusal was tested for the listed boards; nothing covered a board missing from the list or an account step on a board.
fix: job_sources.job_board(url) is the one test, with the common boards named (Adzuna, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, Monster, CareerBuilder, SimplyHired, Talent.com, Jooble, Jobrapido, Lensa, Jobgether, Snagajob, Joblist, Ladders); resolve_job refuses such a link, and the page agent's account step never signs in to, creates an account on, or uses Google with such a site -- it stops and says to use the employer's own careers page.
prevention: Guard an owner's sourcing rule at every point where it matters (the link, and the account step), from one function; keep the list of boards as data in one place.
